name: pstack
description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence. Codex build of the Orca multi-provider fork; skills are shared, tool names resolve via skills/poteto-mode/references/codex-tools.md. Original pstack by Lauren Tan (poteto).

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous, parallelizable agent workflows: go deep first, write less, verify everything
interface.longDescription: pstack guides agent work through poteto-mode's principles, parallel design exploration (architect/arena), adversarial multi-model review (interrogate), root-cause debugging, prose deslopping, and verified delivery. Skills are shared with the Claude Code build; on Codex, tool names resolve via the codex-tools mapping. Roles assigned to another provider run as supervised Orca workers through the run-role skill.
interface.developerName: dev-dingguri (fork of Michael Denyer's port of Lauren Tan's pstack)
